zh-CN.name: Matt Pocock Skills
zh-CN.shortDesc: Matt Pocock 的真实工程 AI Skill 合集，小巧、易改、可组合，适配任意模型做实际开发而非 vibe coding。部分流程需要宿主支持子 Agent、Git 和另行授权的任务跟踪工具。

en-US.name: Matt Pocock Skills
en-US.shortDesc: Matt Pocock's collection of small, composable engineering skills for real application development across any model. Some workflows require host subagents, Git and a separately authorized issue tracker.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 判断哪项技能或工作流程适合当前情况。

en-US.shortDesc: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 以固定提交、分支、标签或合并基点为起点，从仓库规范与正确性两个维度审查代码变更。

en-US.shortDesc: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standa…

zh-CN.shortDesc: 用于设计深模块的共同术语。

en-US.shortDesc: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 用于诊断疑难缺陷和性能回退的循环流程。

en-US.shortDesc: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 建立并完善项目的领域模型。

en-US.shortDesc: Build and sharpen a project's domain model.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过持续追问完善计划或设计，同时形成架构决策记录与术语表。

en-US.shortDesc: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 依据规格或一组任务单实现工作。

en-US.shortDesc: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 按规格和任务依赖图实现功能；需要宿主支持子 Agent、Git 分支及所选任务跟踪工具。

en-US.shortDesc: Implement a specification and its task graph; requires host subagents, Git branches and the chosen issue tracker.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 扫描代码库中加深模块封装的机会，生成可视化 HTML 报告，再对选定机会展开追问。

en-US.shortDesc: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 为拉取请求撰写说明，交代修改内容、验证证据和合并影响。

en-US.shortDesc: Write pull request descriptions covering changes, validation evidence and merge impact.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 构建可丢弃的原型，以验证设计问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 依据高可信的一手来源调查问题，并将发现保存为仓库中的 Markdown 文件。

en-US.shortDesc: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 回顾编程会话，依据日志与现有检查改进开发环境和工作规则。

en-US.shortDesc: Review a coding session using logs and existing checks to improve the development environment and working rules.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置工程技能使用的任务跟踪工具、分流标签与领域文档布局。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 测试驱动开发。

en-US.shortDesc: Test-driven development.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将当前已讨论的内容综合为规格并发布到项目任务跟踪工具，不额外访谈。

en-US.shortDesc: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将计划、规格或当前对话拆成端到端贯通的任务单，声明阻塞依赖并发布到配置的任务跟踪工具。

en-US.shortDesc: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edg…

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过角色状态机分流议题与外部 PR，分类、核验，必要时追问，并形成可交给 Agent 执行的简报。

en-US.shortDesc: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将超出单次 Agent 会话容量的大型工作规划为任务跟踪工具中的共享决策地图，逐项解决决策任务。

en-US.shortDesc: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until…

zh-CN.shortDesc: 生成交互式 Bash 向导，引导用户完成只能由人执行的步骤。

en-US.shortDesc: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 上游 in-progress（测试中）、仅显式手动调用的统筹技能：将工作委派给新上下文后台子 Agent，主会话保留问答，并把有日期与提交依据的知识写入约定的 wiki，供后续会话续接；任务遇到阻力时先提议环境改进，用户接受后再执行。重复任务可在宿主支持时提议定期运行，仍需用户授权；需要子 Agent 能力及另行授权的 wiki、Git 和任务跟踪工具访问。

en-US.shortDesc: Upstream in-progress, explicitly user-invoked coordination skill: delegates work to fresh-context background subagents, keeps the conversation in the main session, and records dated, commit-cited knowledge in an agreed wiki for later sessions. After friction, offers environment changes before acting on acceptance. May propose recurring work where the host supports it; wiki, Git, tracker writes and schedules still require user authorization.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将当前对话交接给一个新的后台 Agent，由其立即接手工作。

en-US.shortDesc: Hand the current conversation off to a fresh background agent that picks up the work immediately.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 围绕当前工作区内拟构建的工作流规格向用户深入追问。

en-US.shortDesc: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 为 TypeScript 仓库接入 dependency-cruiser，使各包成为实现藏于子目录、仅通过入口文件访问的深模块。

en-US.shortDesc: Wire dependency-cruiser into a TypeScript repo so each package is a deep module, with implementation hidden in subfolders and reachable only through its entry-p…

zh-CN.shortDesc: 上游 in-progress（测试中）、仅显式手动调用的软件工厂设计术语与方法：梳理任务、运行及服务，设置自动校验、独立审查和人工审查制动；设计建议不构成部署、创建触发器或合并代码的授权。

en-US.shortDesc: Upstream in-progress, explicitly user-invoked vocabulary and design guide for software factories: maps tasks, runs and services, with automated checks, independent review and human review as brakes. Design guidance does not authorize deployment, trigger creation or merging.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 写作整合阶段：将原始材料组织成叙事节拍，在后续节拍依赖术语前先交代其含义。

en-US.shortDesc: Writing, exploit; assemble raw material into a journey of beats, grounding each term before a beat leans on it.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 写作探索阶段：挖掘原始片段，暂不组织结构。

en-US.shortDesc: Writing, explore: mine raw fragments, no structure yet.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 写作整合阶段：逐段将原始材料组织成文章。

en-US.shortDesc: Writing, exploit: shape raw material into an article, paragraph by paragraph.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Claude Code hooks，在危险 Git 命令执行前阻止 push、reset --hard、clean、branch -D 等操作。

en-US.shortDesc: Set up Claude Code hooks to block dangerous git commands (push, reset --hard, clean, branch -D, etc.) before they execute.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将测试文件中的 as 类型断言迁移为 @total-typescript/shoehorn。

en-US.shortDesc: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建包含章节、习题、答案与讲解且通过 lint 检查的练习目录结构。

en-US.shortDesc: Create exercise directory structures with sections, problems, solutions, and explainers that pass linting.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 在当前仓库配置 Husky pre-commit hooks，执行 lint-staged（Prettier）、类型检查与测试。

en-US.shortDesc: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged (Prettier), type checking, and tests in the current repo.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过持续深入的访谈完善计划或设计。

en-US.shortDesc: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 围绕计划、决策或想法向用户持续深入追问。

en-US.shortDesc: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供另一位 Agent 接手。

en-US.shortDesc: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 在当前工作区内向用户讲解一项新技能或概念。

en-US.shortDesc: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将尚无法完全回答的决策转成问卷，交由他人填写。

en-US.shortDesc: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 停止。

en-US.shortDesc: Stop.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 为 Agent 编写文档。

en-US.shortDesc: Writing documents for agents.
